🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 30s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes flowing where no wind blows — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." the person in their 30s, with freckles asks "So it bleeds." ...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇫🇷 French. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Aaliyah, Amara, Aisling, Daniella and Saule met them at the door — 5 put down. Aaliyah, Amara, Aisling, Daniella, Saule are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aaliyah just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniella just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aaliyah, Amara, Daniella, Vasyl and Carlos met them at the door — 5 put down. Aaliyah, Amara, Daniella, Vasyl, Carlos are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. On day 75, you put down Don't-Look.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Audit and lived to sit here. They faced The Influencer and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
